archetypes.name: Grant: Fit card (gift)
archetypes.description: Gain one card selected to fit the current deck.

archetypes.name: Grant: Fit card draft
archetypes.description: Choose one of four cards selected to fit the current deck.

archetypes.name: Grant: Copies draft
archetypes.description: Choose one of four high-quality fitting cards and gain two copies.

archetypes.name: Grant: Strong card
archetypes.description: Gain one high-quality card selected to fit the current deck.

archetypes.name: Grant: Category draft
archetypes.description: Choose one of four fitting cards from a single deck-relevant category.

archetypes.name: Grant: Card bundle
archetypes.description: Gain a synergistic three-card bundle, or the best available two-card bundle.

archetypes.name: Grant: Transfigured draft
archetypes.description: Choose one of four fitting cards that arrives already transfigured.

archetypes.name: Improve: Transfigure
archetypes.description: Permanently transfigure one valuable eligible card in the current deck.

archetypes.name: Improve: Starter transfigure
archetypes.description: Permanently transfigure up to two eligible starter cards.

archetypes.name: Improve: Keyword modifier
archetypes.description: Reduce the Reclaim cost of one central eligible card in the current deck.

archetypes.name: Improve: Tribal change
archetypes.description: Change one central Character to a different subtype represented in the current deck.

archetypes.name: Remove: Purge
archetypes.description: Permanently remove one poorly fitting card from the current deck.

archetypes.name: Remove: Purge & replace
archetypes.description: Purge one deck card, then choose one of four high-quality replacements.

archetypes.name: Duplicate: Duplicate card
archetypes.description: Choose one of up to three valuable deck cards and gain another copy.

archetypes.name: Dreamsign: Grant dreamsign
archetypes.description: Gain one Dreamsign selected to complement the current deck.

archetypes.name: Dreamsign: Dreamsign draft
archetypes.description: Choose one Dreamsign from two to four candidates selected for the current deck.

archetypes.name: Site: Add a site
archetypes.description: Add one uniformly selected site to the current Dreamscape.
